records.body:

records.body:
Hi Isla,

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Quartz Dynamics* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 3 (2026-07-18), showing real engagement, but no key milestone, no invite, and zero inbound replies to either outreach [email:f616cd94, email:02ccca35]. Solo Starter admin with 8 days left; silence since day 3 lowers odds of unaided activation, though progress so far keeps it non-trivial.

draft.subject: Quick check-in on your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Nice work getting your first project set up last week. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding a few real tasks to that project is usually the step where things start clicking.

If it's useful, I'm happy to jump on a short call this week and walk through what you're trying to track with Quartz Dynamics, so we can get the next step sorted quickly.

Either way, just reply here and it comes straight to me.

Best,
Priya
